Madam Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 617, the  American Music Tourism Act of 2025, led by the gentlewoman from  Tennessee (Mrs. Harshbarger), my good friend and a great member of the  Committee on Energy and Commerce.

Madam Speaker, this bipartisan legislation directs the National  Travel and Tourism Office…

Mrs. HARSHBARGER. Mr. Speaker, I thank my colleague, Chairman Gus  Bilirakis, who I affectionately call Gus, and Ranking Member Pallone  for supporting this act.

We have the opportunity…

…secure our medical product supply chain by  requiring the FDA to establish an office in a country that has signed  the Abraham Accords.

I am grateful to Representatives Harshbarger and Vargas for their  work to facilitate operations between the FDA and regulatory  authorities and innovators in Abraham Accords countries.
